engine.measurement_policy: voice-quality metrics restricted to sustained voiced notes; deterministic scoring rubric v5

pitch.range_semitones_note: Robust range (2.5th-97.5th percentile of voiced frames). Immune to single octave-error frames.

voice_quality.cpps_note: Cepstral Peak Prominence (smoothed, Praat). Research-standard clarity measure. SCORED: one of the four voice_quality sub-scores, anchored to the pro reference pack (10 at the pack median) when a calibration file is loaded.

strain.method: high pitch + above-median loudness + HNR >=4 dB below this take's own median
strain.reliability: medium — heuristic; intentional grit also trips it, confirm by ear at the timestamps

voice_quality.interpretation: Mild breathiness or intentional grit; normal sung-note perturbation; elevated amplitude perturbation.

reference.note: Speech norms are for sustained spoken vowels; sung notes with vibrato run naturally higher. Interpretation above uses singing-oriented bands.

harmonic_balance.note: Global tonal-balance descriptor over the whole file (includes silence/consonants). NOT clinical HNR — see voice_quality.hnr_db_median.

resonance.singers_formant_note: Median 2-4 kHz vs 80 Hz-2 kHz energy on active frames. Heuristic bands; NOT part of the technical score — no pro-pack anchors exist for it yet (unlike CPPS, which is anchored and scored).

dynamics.reference_note: dB relative to the loudest frame in this file (internal contrast, not absolute loudness).

rhythm.measures: onset density & regularity of the vocal delivery — NOT timing vs the backing (see groove)

vowel_space.reliability: medium — vowel identity from F1/F2 is approximate on sung (vs spoken) vowels; excluded above F0 350 Hz where formant tracking breaks down

vibrato.onset_delay_note: Time from note start until vibrato blooms. Pros typically ~0.2-0.6 s; near-zero can read as nervous wobble, very late as an afterthought.

intonation.caveat: Grid-deviation is a proxy: expressive slides, blue notes and non-12-TET material register as deviation. Interpret alongside the recording context.

registers.reliability: medium — verify by ear at the timestamps

breath.method: pitch slope over the final 0.5 s of each phrase
breath.note: Sagging endings on LONG phrases suggest breath running out; on short phrases, intentional fall-offs are common in rock/soul — judge by ear. MEASUREMENT CAVEAT: the tail window is a fixed 0.5 s, not a proportion of the phrase. On material whose phrases are shorter than about 1 s the window spans most of the phrase (and possibly what precedes it), so the slope it fits is not the same quantity measured on a 5 s phrase. Compare pct_sagging_endings between takes of similar median_phrase_s.

range_map.note: Time-weighted from this take only. Compare across takes/songs for a true personal range picture.

onsets.method: first 0.25 s of each sustained note vs its settled centre
onsets.note: Scooping can be deliberate style — consistency matters more than the raw percentage. Compare with the original via tools/compare_takes.py to see whether the original scoops in the same places.

harmonics.method: per-sustained-note FFT, harmonic peaks at k*F0, median across notes
harmonics.note: Numeric overtone profile. On separated stems, separation artifacts add noise to upper harmonics — read H5+ cautiously.

word_drift.method: per held note >= 0.6 s: vibrato-smoothed contour spread over vowel frames vs largest excursion within ±80 ms of each energy-dip / voicing-gap boundary
word_drift.read: The vowels themselves wander; the word boundaries add little. Coach steadiness on the sustained vowel (messa di voce, straw) first.
word_drift.reliability: medium — boundaries are inferred from energy dips and voicing gaps inside a held note, not from lyrics; a breathy vowel can register as a boundary. Confirm at the timestamps.
word_drift.note: Diagnostic only — never scored, never part of the /10.

environment_risk.note: No obvious global capture-risk marker was detected.

visual_diagnostics.note: Supporting visual diagnostics. In karaoke/live-room recordings, backing track bleed and mic clipping can affect these traces.

technical_score.capture_fair_note: Rubric with the capture-sensitive components (voice_quality and dynamics_expression) excluded (weights renormalised). Jitter/shimmer/HNR and effective dynamic range partly measure the recording chain and stem-separation artefacts: vintage masters run through separation read far worse than clean modern captures of an equal voice. Use capture_fair on BOTH sides for any take-vs-original or cross-era comparison; use overall_score for a singer's absolute result and self-progress. Note breath_support is deliberately NOT excluded: phrase-ending sag is air running out, not the room, so it is scored on a phone or room take like any other.
technical_score.provenance: deterministic_rubric_v5 — computed from measured audio features; identical audio yields an identical score; no LLM involvement; anchored to professional reference distribution

intonation_accuracy.input: median abs grid deviation = 20.0 cents — matches or beats 58.0% of 50 pro references
intonation_accuracy.formula: 10 at pro-reference median (20.0 cents), 0 at 45 cents, linear

pitch_stability.input: median intra-note drift = 57.0 cents — matches or beats 58.0% of 50 pro references
pitch_stability.formula: 10 at pro-reference median (62.55 cents), 0 at 80 cents, linear

voice_quality.input: jitter = 1.3254% — matches or beats 12.0% of 50 pro references; shimmer = 14.6239% — matches or beats 8.0% of 50 pro references; HNR = 11.62 dB — matches or beats 24.0% of 50 pro references; CPPS = 13.48 dB — matches or beats 8.0% of 50 pro references
voice_quality.formula: mean of jitter/shimmer/HNR/CPPS sub-scores (Praat, per sustained note)

vibrato_control.input: 31.0% of long notes carry vibrato (10 at >=40%); rate 4.68 Hz (ideal 4.877-5.99); extent 52.8 cents (ideal 52.55-78.02); intra-note drift 57.0 cents (straight-tone path)
vibrato_control.formula: best of vibrato-quality path and straight-tone steadiness path (consistent straight tone is a valid professional style)

dynamics_expression.formula: best of phrase-level shaping and effective range, graded to the pro distribution (10 at the professional median, ~7 across the pro range, floored not zeroed beyond it)

phrase_control.input: median phrase length = 3.96 s — matches or beats 54.0% of 50 pro references
phrase_control.formula: 10 at pro-reference median (3.8 s), 0 at 0.5 s, linear

breath_support.input: 15 of 30 phrase endings sag = 50.0% — matches or beats 6.0% of 50 pro references

technical_score.scope_note: Technical execution only. Artistry, emotion, interpretation and style-appropriateness are human judgements and are not part of this number. Any 'listener impact' figure elsewhere in a report is a subjective estimate, not a measurement.

entry_accuracy.not_a_score_note: ENTRY ACCURACY is a diagnostic, not a score. It is NOT part of the overall or the capture-fair number and must never be quoted as a /10 or averaged with one. An onset_accuracy score component was built, tested and rejected in Aug 2026 for making agreement with the singer's ear worse.
entry_accuracy.method: first 0.25 s of each sustained note vs its settled centre
entry_accuracy.reliability_reason: degraded capture (HNR 11.62 dB, jitter 1.3254%) — the onset measurement is plausible and is reported, but a rough room makes note starts harder to detect. Read it as indicative.
entry_accuracy.basis: 29.5% of entries land clean — matches or beats 34.0% of 50 pro references (pro median 33.2%)

prescriptions.method: deterministic_prescription_engine_v1 — rules over measured values; exercise content verbatim from the library; no LLM selection

primary.selector_heading: If the main limiter is BREATH / SUPPORT
evidence: 50.0% of phrase endings sag (intentional fall-offs also register — confirm by ear)
primary.primary_exercise_detail:
- Use when: suspended breath control and phrase stamina.
- Pedagogical target: Suspended Breath Control.
- How to do it: Inhale for 4 counts, suspend (hold with open glottis) for 4, exhale for 4; increase to 10+ counts.
- How it should feel: Inhale low and wide, suspend without closing the throat, then release like a slow leak.
- Common failure / safety note: Stop or reduce intensity if dizziness, shoulder lifting, throat gripping, or breath-holding appears.
- Pass/Fail metric: Counts are even and the throat stays open during the suspension.
- Song transfer: Apply the same sensation to one short phrase only; do not run the whole song until the cue holds.
primary.next_take_cue: Keep the ribs wide and let the air meter out slowly.

supporting.selector_heading: If vibrato is absent, uneven, forced, or wobbly
evidence: vibrato on only 31.0% of long notes — attempted but inconsistent
supporting.primary_exercise_detail:
- Use when (added at distillation): vibrato is absent, rigid, or difficult to initiate without jaw or throat involvement.
- Pedagogical target (added at distillation): Flexible, pitch-based oscillation around a stable centre.
- How to do it: To initiate the muscular oscillation, gently and rapidly toggle between two close pitches, such as a half-step or a whole-step apart. You can use the initial intervals of the "Jaws" theme (a half-step) or "Happy Birthday" (a whole-step) as a starting point. The goal is to encourage laryngeal flexibility until you can "let go" and allow the primary note to waver naturally.
- How it should feel (added at distillation): Easy and released, with the pitch movement staying out of the jaw and throat.
- Common failure / safety note (added at distillation): Stop if the jaw shakes, the throat grips, or the pitch is driven by force rather than released coordination.
- Pass/Fail metric (added at distillation): The two pitches alternate evenly, then the sustained note releases into a small oscillation without visible jaw movement or throat tension.
- Song transfer (added at distillation): Apply the released oscillation to one comfortable sustained note in the song, keeping the onset straight and easy first.
supporting.next_take_cue: Let vibrato emerge from balanced airflow and release; never force it from the jaw or throat.

prescriptions.note: Primary drill = highest-severity measured limiter. Candi may choose among the category's listed exercises using drill history, or justify a deviation in prose.

diagnostic_flags.value: median 57.0 cents drift within sustained notes
diagnostic_flags.interpretation: Held notes wander rather than sitting still.
diagnostic_flags.likely_cause: Breath pressure decay or TA-dominant registration pulling pitch.
diagnostic_flags.intervention: Fry to Head / Lip Trill / Messa di Voce on single pitches
